newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SELL PLN ONE BLN NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SELL PLN ONE BLN NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 200 million zlotys of its 91-day NBP-bills and set the minimum price at 95.29, up from 95.28 on September 3, after Polish banks bid for 451 million zlotys of the bills, it said.
It also sold 800 million zlotys of its 273-day NBP-bills and left the minimum price flat at 86.89 after banks bid for 1.003 billion of the bills.
The average yield of the shorter paper was 19.42 percent, against 18.60 percent for a comparable 13-week T-bill sold at Monday's primary auction.
